

No UI. `web/app/src/editor/schema.ts` builds the BlockNote schema with
exactly the catalogue's block set: the default specs for `paragraph`,
`heading`, `bulletListItem`, `numberedListItem`, `checkListItem`, `table`,
`codeBlock`, `quote`, `image`, plus three custom specs: `source`
(`props.markdown`, rendered as a monospace textarea, edited as plain
text), `callout` (`props.kind`, children allowed), and `heading` extended
with an `anchor` prop (default `""`). Every other default spec (`video`,
`audio`, `file`, `toggle` and so on) is left out. `web/app/src/editor/bytes.ts`
maps a ProseMirror selection to `{start, end}` byte offsets in the stored
Markdown using the block `range` and run `offset` fields, and back, counting
UTF-8 bytes of the run text. The prototype's
`comments/anchors.ts` is the shape to port from (block id + character
offset there; bytes here).

```ts
test("selection inside a bold run maps to bytes after the marker", () => {
  const blocks = [{ id: "1", type: "paragraph", props: {}, children: [], range: { start: 0, end: 9 },
    content: [{ type: "text", text: "a ", styles: {}, offset: 0 }, { type: "text", text: "bø", styles: { bold: true }, offset: 5 }] }]
  // "a **bø**": "ø" is 2 bytes; selecting "ø" (chars 3..4 of the paragraph text) is bytes 6..8
  expect(selectionToBytes(blocks, { from: 3, to: 4 })).toEqual({ start: 6, end: 8 })
  expect(bytesToSelection(blocks, { start: 6, end: 8 })).toEqual({ from: 3, to: 4 })
})
```
